h1.en: Electric 10 vs Electric 15 at the Same 15 kW: 15 kW beside the Contactor article
h1.zh: 同为15千瓦时，电动10和电动15有何不同：对照「接触器」时，15 kW仍在原页

directAnswer.en: Electric 10 Series and Electric 15 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai that both list a 15 kW motor. Electric 10 lists 21 m³/h, 23 MPa and 25 m horizontal with no vertical line. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Contactor.
directAnswer.zh: 电动10系列和电动15是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵，电机都标出 15 kW。电动10标出 21 m³/h、23 MPa、水平 25 m，没有垂直行。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Contactor。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Contactor. The picture shows Magnetic contactor. Electric 10 Series and Electric 15 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai that both list a 15 kW motor. Max. aggregate size: Electric 10 Series lists 2 cm and below. Electric 15 lists 1–3 cm. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. Equal motor kilowatts do not equal the same output or the same distance layout. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Contactor。画面是Magnetic contactor。电动10系列和电动15是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵，电机都标出 15 kW。最大骨料粒径：电动10系列标出 2 cm and below；电动15标出 1–3 cm。电动10系列有、电动15没有的行：最大出口压力 23 MPa；料斗容积 0.1 m³；水平输送距离 25 m；整机重量 400 kg。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

body.en: Electric 10 lists 21 m³/h, 23 MPa and 25 m horizontal with no vertical line. Dimensions: Electric 10 Series lists 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm. Electric 15 lists 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm. Electric 10 Series lists entries that Electric 15 does not: Max. outlet pressure 23 MPa. Hopper capacity 0.1 m³. Horizontal pumping distance 25 m. Main unit weight 400 kg. Open /en/products/electric-10-series-concrete-pump/ for Electric 10 Series and /en/products/electric-15-concrete-pump/ for Electric 15.
body.zh: 电动10标出 21 m³/h、23 MPa、水平 25 m，没有垂直行。外形尺寸：电动10系列标出 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm；电动15标出 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm。电动15有、电动10系列没有的行：垂直输送高度 15–20 m；水平输送距离 60–80 m；输送管内径 100–125 mm；整机重量 450 kg。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

body.en: Electric 15 lists 8–10 m³/h, 15–20 m vertical, 60–80 m horizontal and a 100–125 mm pipe, and it lists no outlet pressure. The same shown value on a shared label: Motor power is 15 kW on both pages. Electric 15 lists entries that Electric 10 Series does not: Vertical delivery height 15–20 m. Horizontal delivery distance 60–80 m. Delivery pipe diameter 100–125 mm. Total weight 450 kg. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 电动15标出 8–10 m³/h、垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m、管内径 100–125 mm，并且不写出口压力。同一标题下数值相同的有：电机功率两边都是 15 kW。电机千瓦数相同，不等于产量相同，也不等于距离的写法相同。

body.en: Theoretical output: Electric 10 Series lists 21 m³/h. Electric 15 lists 8–10 m³/h. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 理论输送量：电动10系列标出 21 m³/h；电动15标出 8–10 m³/h。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。看电动10系列请打开 /zh/products/electric-10-series-concrete-pump/，看电动15请打开 /zh/products/electric-15-concrete-pump/。

question.en: Does Electric 10 Series list the same theoretical output as Electric 15?
question.zh: 电动10系列和电动15的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 10 Series lists 21 m³/h. Electric 15 lists 8–10 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Contactor.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动10系列标出 21 m³/h。电动15标出 8–10 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Contactor画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 10 Series list the same max. aggregate size as Electric 15?
question.zh: 电动10系列和电动15的最大骨料粒径一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 10 Series lists 2 cm and below. Electric 15 lists 1–3 cm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Contactor.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动10系列标出 2 cm and below。电动15标出 1–3 cm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Contactor画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 10 Series list the same dimensions as Electric 15?
question.zh: 电动10系列和电动15的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 10 Series lists 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm. Electric 15 lists 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Contactor.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动10系列标出 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm。电动15标出 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Contactor画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is max. outlet pressure missing on Electric 15?
question.zh: 为什么电动15没有最大出口压力？

answer.en: The Electric 15 page does not list that label. Electric 10 Series lists 23 MPa. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Contactor.
answer.zh: 电动15这一页没有标出这个标题。电动10系列标出的是 23 MPa。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Contactor画面里印出的数字。
